reference.pathophysiology: Foamy Bitot spots with night blindness draw high-dose vitamin-A with measles protocols while rosary-bowed rickets takes stoss cholecalciferol with calcium; koilonychic-pica iron with B12-folate sorts against lead stippling and hookworm, and iodised salt with zinc rounds the traces.
